Furthermore, ζ measurements conducted in Milli-Q water indicated a negative charge for PS (-46 ± 2 mV), PVC (-48 ± 1 mV), and SiO2 (-27 ± 4 mV) particles. || The hydrodynamic size of the particles and the zeta potential (ζ) were assessed by utilizing a Zetasizer Nanodevice (Malvern Panalytical, Malvern, UK).

First, we determined the CCC values of PS and PVC nanoplastics in different CaCl2 concentrations using DLS. The CCC values for both particles were not found even in a ∼1000 mM CaCl2 solution, indicating the stability of the particles against homoaggregation. The measured ζ values are reported in Table S3. || The hydrodynamic size of the particles and the zeta potential (ζ) were assessed by utilizing a Zetasizer Nanodevice (Malvern Panalytical, Malvern, UK).
